incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference runtime (model-runner-v2) in prod us-west-2. Spike from ~0.5% -> 12% starting 2026-02-14 15:42 UTC. Auto-threshold triggered. Pages: @alyssa_oncall.
alyssa_oncall: taking pager. can someone link runbook? @eng_runtime_lead are you around?
eng_runtime_lead: here. initial triage: multiple segfaults / OOMs in model-runner process. grabbing logs and cores. sample stacktrace below.
```
[2026-02-14T15:43:01Z] model-runner-v2[pid=4122]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8c1a2
#0 0x7f8c1a2 in quant_attention_kernel(...)
#1 0x7f8c3b4 in kv_cache_commit(...)
#2 0x55aa1f in run_inference_loop(...)
```
support_ops: customer impact: ~5% of requests returning 502, top affected tenants: acme-inc, beta-saas. p50 latency +60ms.
alyssa_oncall: executing runbook step 1: emergency capacity. scaling model-runner-v2 ASG +2 now.
eng_runtime_lead: scale triggered. also enabling fallback: route 20% traffic to model-runner-v1 (lower memory, lower perf) to reduce pressure. doing config flip in router.
pm_lina: prepping customer comms; flagging potential degraded perf for some tenants. no data loss reported so far.
eng_runtime_lead: seeing repeated mmap failures and GPU OOM logs prior to segfaults. collecting heap profiles and nv-host logs. running: kubectl logs -n prod deploy/model-runner-v2 --since=10m and collect-core.sh on crashed hosts.
alyssa_oncall: cores uploaded to /shared/incidents/1778005432/cores. linking runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-oom
sre_jordan: will attempt kernel tuning on canary node: increase vm.max_map_count and overcommit_ratio=80, then observe. applying to canary now.
eng_runtime_lead: also doing rolling restart of model-runner-v2 DaemonSet to reclaim fragmented memory: kubectl rollout restart ds/model-runner-v2 -n prod (canary 2 pods).
support_ops: timeline: 15:42 start, 15:46 page, 15:48 scale start, 15:53 fallback live. error rate down from 12% -> 3.7% after fallback.
alyssa_oncall: good progress. keep metrics on error-rate, request latency, and GPU mem pressure. if error-rate <1% for 10m we'll close pager and open postmortem.
eng_runtime_lead: initial suspect: regression in quant_attention kernel from canary build rolled at 03:12 UTC. suspect sha a1b2c3f. recommend rollback of that build for v2 once stable.
pm_lina: scheduling postmortem and customer update. next oncall at 17:00 UTC — @sre_jordan will take follow-up for stabilizing/rollback coordination.
sre_jordan: ack. I'll monitor and coordinate rollback window with infra.
incident-bot: RESOLVE: error rate stabilized below threshold at 15:59 UTC. Pager closed by alyssa_oncall. Action items: create incident/1778005432 PM with attachments: cores, heap profiles, nv-host logs, suspect sha.
alyssa_oncall: closing thread. great work team :heart:
